diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_launch_template.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_eks_fargate_profile.fargate: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.fargate is redundant — already implied by attribute references

:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng lists :resource.aws_launch_template.ng in depends_on, but the ASG already references the launch template via aws_launch_template.ng[each.key].id and .latest_version in mixed_instances_policy, so the implicit dependency already guarantees the ordering; the explicit depends_on entry is redundant.

:resource.aws_eks_fargate_profile.fargate lists :resource.aws_iam_role.fargate in depends_on, but pod_execution_role_arn = aws_iam_role.fargate.0.arn already establishes the same dependency implicitly, so the explicit depends_on entry is redundant. (The dependency on the eks-fargate policy attachment is still needed.)

:resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng lists :resource.aws_iam_role.ng in depends_on, but node_role_arn = aws_iam_role.ng.0.arn already establishes the dependency implicitly, so the explicit depends_on entry is redundant. (The dependencies on the eks-ng, eks-cni and ecr-read policy attachments remain necessary.)
